item.title: Wisconsin Democrats announce marijuana legalization bill
item.description: In a bid to capitalize on recent bipartisan pushes to regulate the state's hemp industry, Wisconsin Democrats have introduced a bill to fully legalize marijuana. But the plan is doomed in the Republican-led Legislature. The post Wisconsin Democrats announce marijuana legalization bill appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Democratic challenger Rebecca Cooke outraises US Rep. Derrick Van Orden
item.description: Eau Claire Democrat Rebecca Cooke has outraised Republican Congressman Derrick Van Orden for the first time in Wisconsin's hotly contested 3rd Congressional District race. The post Democratic challenger Rebecca Cooke outraises US Rep. Derrick Van Orden appeared first on WPR.

item.title: UW System president says AI can help move Wisconsin forward
item.description: Universities of Wisconsin President Jay Rothman says artificial intelligence is no longer an abstract idea, but is now transforming how the state’s public universities operate. The post UW System president says AI can help move Wisconsin forward appeared first on WPR.

item.title: ‘In Care Of’ postcard project celebrates family caregivers in Wisconsin
item.description: One in five Wisconsinites is a family caregiver and yet their work can often feel invisible. Last year, a researcher and a caregiver came together to give voice to this group of people. They asked caregivers to submit postcards expressing moments of joy and difficulty as they take care of loved ones. The result is a new online exhibit. The post ‘In Care Of’ postcard project celebrates family caregivers in Wisconsin appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Central Wisconsin beekeepers look to education and preparation as spring nears
item.description: Beek Meet offers multiple session tracks tailored to new, intermediate and experienced beekeepers. The post Central Wisconsin beekeepers look to education and preparation as spring nears appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Dugan’s attorneys argue ICE had no right to make courthouse arrest
item.description: Former Judge Hannah Dugan was found guilty of impeding a federal immigration proceeding. Her attorneys are trying to overturn that conviction. The post Dugan’s attorneys argue ICE had no right to make courthouse arrest appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Who made that footprint? Wisconsin naturalist investigates animal tracks.
item.description: In Wisconsin, wolves, turkeys, squirrels and rabbits are most active this time of year. A northwoods naturalist explains how to differentiate between snowprints. The post Who made that footprint? Wisconsin naturalist investigates animal tracks. appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Second data center project proposed in Beaver Dam
item.description: A second data center development is being proposed in Beaver Dam. Local officials say would be much smaller than Meta’s data center campus currently under construction. The post Second data center project proposed in Beaver Dam appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Mining company receives state approval to conduct more drilling in northern Wisconsin
item.description: On Thursday, the Wisconsin Department of Natural Resources granted approval to mining company GreenLight Wisconsin’s plans to drill up to 20 holes across 15 sites as it explores the Bend deposit in Taylor County near Medford. The post Mining company receives state approval to conduct more drilling in northern Wisconsin appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin US Sen. Ron Johnson opposes Trump’s call for Republicans to ‘take over’ elections
item.description: Republican U.S. Sen. Ron Johnson says he doesn't agree with President Donald Trump's call for Republicans to "take over" elections in up to 15 states, but setting standards like proof of citizenship for federal elections is "fitting and proper." The post Wisconsin US Sen. Ron Johnson opposes Trump’s call for Republicans to ‘take over’ elections appeared first on WPR.
